messages.author: c69bf3eeace29d5d
messages.subject: ULSM fit statistic (continuous variables)
parts:
Hi, what is the exact formula for the robust chi-square statistic obtained under estimator ="ULSM"

Lisrel uses the normal-theory reweighted quadratic form to obtain a chi-square under ULS.

Mplus uses the Satorra-Bentler scaling, involving some matrices U (derived from the model) and Gamma (asympotic covariance matrix).

Is it this latter formula that is employed with ULSM? And where can I find the exact formulas?

The mplus chi-square is not even asymptotically a chi-square, but this holds for the Lisrel version.

messages.subject: Re: ULSM fit statistic (continuous variables)

On 02/07/2013 03:10 PM, Nj�l Foldnes wrote:
> Hi, what is the exact formula for the robust chi-square statistic
> obtained under estimator ="ULSM"
>
> Lisrel uses the normal-theory reweighted quadratic form to obtain a
> chi-square under ULS.
>
> Mplus uses the Satorra-Bentler scaling, involving some matrices U
> (derived from the model) and Gamma (asympotic covariance matrix).
>
> Is it this latter formula that is employed with ULSM? And where can I
> find the exact formulas?

Yes. The same formulas as for the Satorra-Bentler correction are used,
but the three ingredients (E.inv: inverted information matrix, Delta:
jacobian of sigma element wrt model parameters, WLS.V: weight matrix)
are based on the ULS results. For example, WLS.V is simply the identity
matrix.

One day, there will be a technical document containing all the formulas
used in lavaan. One day.

Yves.
